en.hubeali: From him, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Muhammad Bin Ziyad, from Haroun Bin Jariya who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘I intermingle with the Magians, so I eat from their meals’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’.
en.sarwar: 8. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from ’Isma‘il ibn Mehran from Muhammad ibn Ziyad from Harun ibn Kharijah who has said the following: “
I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam, if I can associate with Zoroastrians and eat from their food. He (the Imam) said, ‘No.’”
